scope: EXP-06 / DEC-20,21,22,28: finite correction, independent branch and reading recovery engineering delivery

deployment.build: full Dockerfile rebuild including final mobile story header correction

validation.groupCoverage: active generation and partial shared-input group refused; complete group forks twice, order and supported strategy retained
validation.recoveryCoverage: parallel duplicate, stale preview, process restart, lost POST response and reload recover exactly one branch
validation.readingCoverage: annotation/revoke/idempotency, whitespace-only latest-reply layout, post-request stale refusal, per-story anchor restoration

deployedReadOnlyChecks.mutationPolicy: Login then GET-only API and generation-frame guards; local unsaved annotation preview/cancel only

Actual deployment verified read-only; branch writes and lifecycle exercised in disposable databases
Human visual, real-device/input-method and real-model continuation quality remain unaccepted
No generic third-party adaptation agent, full script support or branch graph delivered
